candidates.title: Same Pinky, Three Rooms
candidates.one_line_concept: The promise is not one big vow; it is the same tiny pinky-hook showing up in three ordinary rooms: before the day, during the laugh, after the hard moment.
candidates.emotional_truth: Real staying looks repetitive. Not dramatic. The same small gesture keeps returning when neither of them has a speech ready.
candidates.relatable_trigger: Couples who have one dumb-small ritual that means more than the actual words.

visual_evidence.scene: Aachu and Zuv stand in the kitchen or doorway, half-ready for the day, pinkies hooked between them while one still holds a mug or phone.

visual_evidence.text: I am always there for you
visual_evidence.scene: They sit on the floor eating from one plate, laughing mid-bite, pinkies still linked awkwardly because neither wants to let go first.

visual_evidence.text: in your good and bad times ..
visual_evidence.scene: After a hard evening, they sit on opposite sides of the bed or couch, bodies tired and quiet, only their pinkies touching in the middle.

candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Medium-low if the rooms stay specific and imperfect; high if it becomes clean hand shots with quote text.

candidates.title: Promise Without The Speech
candidates.one_line_concept: Aachu and Zuv never make a grand promise out loud; they answer each other with a pinky when words would make the moment too heavy.
candidates.emotional_truth: Sometimes love is knowing when not to over-explain. The hand arrives before the reassurance does.
candidates.relatable_trigger: That couple habit where one person silently asks, 'Are we okay?' and the other answers with a gesture.

visual_evidence.scene: One of them offers a pinky from just outside the frame while the other is still looking away, pretending not to need reassurance.

visual_evidence.text: I am always there for you
visual_evidence.scene: During a happy little victory, one reaches for the other's pinky under the table while everyone else is busy with the moment.

visual_evidence.text: in your good and bad times ..

candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Medium; under-table and not-facing-yet details must carry it.

candidates.title: The Pinky Survives The Mood
candidates.one_line_concept: The promise stays the same even when their faces change: playful, smug, exhausted, annoyed, still choosing the tiny link.
candidates.emotional_truth: Being there for someone does not always look soft. Sometimes it looks like staying connected while still being a little irritated.
candidates.relatable_trigger: Couples who can be annoyed and affectionate at the exact same time.

visual_evidence.scene: Aachu and Zuv make the pinky promise with overly serious faces, like they know it is childish but sacred anyway.

visual_evidence.text: I am always there for you
visual_evidence.scene: One is celebrating something tiny and the other is proudly dramatic about it, pinky raised like a ceremonial witness.

visual_evidence.text: in your good and bad times ..

candidates.risk_of_being_generic: Low if expressions stay imperfect; medium if annoyance becomes sitcom gender-role teasing.
